results.name: The Whizzbang debuts in Level 7 wave 5 with its hint, two opening and one in the t12 drop, and comes back in W6, W8 and W9
A credited touch lights it; a second later the rocket pins the four nearest in its column whole and bangs at the top
A bud right under the bang blooms even when the column held more than four
The rocket plays the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS (swaying)
An uncredited strike, a power and a sun link bloom it plainly, with no rocket
A credited chain lights it on a half-second fuse, and a lit one turns every later chain away
A rocket that pins an unlit whizzbang lights it on a half-second fuse
A Lullaby holds the fuse; lit or flying never costs a life, unlit costs one
The bot: the forecast pins what the rocket pins, an unlit one is worth its column, a lit one is a ghost worth nothing
A rocket that meets a tunnel mouth comes out of the other and flies on; a downward exit stops at the floor
A rocket lit under Ember Rose deals 3, even at tier 0
The bloomed flower stays where the rocket burst
The aim forecast meets a moving guardian: it says she is hit exactly when the real rocket links her
